_comment: Condensed from Apollo 12's CSM checklists (data/missions/apollo_12/) for Apollo 14's flight: the launch as Apollo 12's, Antares docked from TLI to the undocking, the midcourse corrections on the SPS or the RCS, DOI flown by Kitty Hawk with Antares docked, the separation maneuver after the undocking and Kitty Hawk's circularization (CIRC), the plane change over Antares on the surface, the direct rendezvous, LM JETT and TEI [adapted for this simulator]. Keys: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for; it opens at the start, and as the crew comes back aboard Kitty Hawk, in one. Antares's are in lm_checklists.json.

steps.text: LIFTOFF light and the clock: the CMC in P11 (V16 N62: speed, altitude rate, altitude)
Roll and pitch program: the FDAI rolls to the flight azimuth, then pitches downrange
Inboard cutoff: LV ENG 5 on
Outboard cutoff, staging: S-II SEP on, the S-II's engines to thrust
Skirt sep: S-II SEP out
Tower jettison
Guidance initiate: the IU steers to orbit
S-II cutoff, staging, S-IVB ignition: LV ENG 1 on until its thrust
S-IVB cutoff: LV ENG 1 on; insertion
V82E: the parking orbit, about 100 nmi
Watch the S-IVB/IU: TLI is automatic at the GO-for-TLI TIG
TLI ignition
TLI cutoff: verify apogee beyond the Moon (V82E)
CSM/LV SEP: transposition, docking and LM extraction
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the ground's uplink
Mission Control: the PAD (P27 takes the state vector and the P30 loads: UPLINK ACTY)
UP TLM CM - BLOCK
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
P52 option 1, the preferred REFSMMAT (IMU realign)
CMC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 SPS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
DELTA-V THRUST A - NORMAL
DELTA-V THRUST B - NORMAL (both banks for LOI and TEI; bank A alone for a short burn)
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - SPS cutoff
DELTA-V THRUST A and B - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the THC, then PRO
For the separation maneuver after the undocking and the small midcourse corrections, a few feet a second
UP TLM CM - ACCEPT, in P00, for the ground's uplink
Mission Control: the PAD (P27 takes the state vector and the P30 loads)
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
CMC MODE - AUTO
V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to the burn attitude, +X along the delta-V
At TIG-5 s V99 flashing: PRO; the four +X jets fire
Monitor V16N85 (VG) to zero
Trim N85 residuals with the THC, then PRO

checklists.title: Lunar orbit, Antares's landing and TEI

steps.text: LOI PAD at 80:31; fly it with the SPS burn checklist behind the Moon
Lunar orbit confirmed
DOI PAD at 84:52: Kitty Hawk takes the docked stack down to 9 nmi at the low point; fly it with the SPS burn checklist
The separation PAD, for after the undocking (UP TLM CM - ACCEPT)
CMC MODE - FREE, then UNDOCK on GO for undocking
The separation maneuver, 0.8 ft/s radially down: fly it with the RCS burn checklist
The CIRC PAD at 104:34, taking Kitty Hawk back up to 60 nmi (UP TLM CM - ACCEPT)
Fly CIRC with the SPS burn checklist
Antares flies powered descent to Fra Mauro: track it
The plane change's PAD (LOPC-1), putting the orbit over Antares for the liftoff
Fly LOPC-1 with the SPS burn checklist
Antares's direct rendezvous: TPI on its first revolution; it brakes 40 m out; face it with the probe and dock
LM JETT on GO for Pyro Arm (the ascent stage stays behind)
TEI PAD at 146:59; fly it with the SPS burn checklist
Transearth coast
MCC PADs to trim the entry corridor (vacuum perigee ~35 km); fly them with the RCS burn checklist
V37E 61E - P61 Entry preparation: PRO at N61 (the target, HEADSUP -1 lift up), N60 and N63 (the EMS's)
P62 V50N25 00041: CM/SM SEP (15 min before entry interface)
CMC MODE - AUTO
PRO, and PRO at N61: the entry attitude (N22), then P63 (N64)
SCS ATT SOURCE - CMC (the CMC rolls the lift)
ELS LOGIC - ON
ELS AUTO
0.05 g: P64 entry guidance (N74: roll, velocity, drag)
P65 up-control if the range asks for it (PRO at the flashing V16N69); P67 final phase (N66)
1,000 ft/s: PRO at the flashing V16N67 (range to go, latitude, longitude) - P00
Drogues at 24,000 ft
Mains at 10,000 ft
Splashdown
At the LEB (SEAT): OPTICS ZERO - OFF, MODE - CMC
V37E 52E - P52 IMU realign
V04N06: V22E option E (1 PREF 2 NOM 3 REFS 4 LS); PRO
V06N22 new gimbal angles, MG under 70: PRO, coarse align
V50N25 00015: PRO for two stars (00405: roll heads down)
Star 1: PRO at V01N70; OPTICS MAN, centre it, MARK
Star 2: OPTICS CMC, PRO at V01N70; MAN, centre, MARK
V06N05 star angle difference under 0.02: PRO
V06N93 torquing angles: PRO to torque the gyros
V50N25 00014: V37E 00E; OPTICS MODE - CMC
